description: This file defines an enum called Permission representing various access permissions (READ, WRITE, ADMINISTRATE) for entities in the Eclipse Ditto platform, including utility methods for converting permissions to string and JSON representations.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Enumeration of access permissions with utility methods for JSON conversion and string representation.

methods.name: allToString
methods.description: Concatenates all Permission enum values into a single string with delimiters and brackets.

methods.name: toJsonKey
methods.description: Converts a Permission enum constant to a JsonKey object.
